sections.overview: Macroglossum trochilus is a day-flying African hawkmoth.
sections.identification: Adults visit flowers in bright daylight.
sections.habitat: Records extend from southern to tropical Africa.
sections.diet: Larvae feed on Galium and Rubia; adults sip nectar.
sections.behavior: It is regularly active by day.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific breeding details remain poorly documented.
sections.ecology: Recorded larval hosts are both in Rubiaceae.
sections.conservation: No species-level conservation assessment was located.
